definition.question: Which departments drove this month's change in patients waiting over 30 minutes?
definition.description: Drivers of the month-on-month change: for each referral department, visits that waited over 30 minutes in the latest month to date and on the same days of the month before, the change (the parts add up to the total change), the share seen within 30 minutes and its change in points, with the monthly trend of over-30 visits.
